scope.title: How far does this change go?

mockup.title: Do you want to see a visual mockup before code is written?
mockup.display: Yes: Planning publishes an HTML mockup of the chosen layout

header-layout.title: Which header layout should the card use?
header-layout.other: We actually need to follow the best practices and try some designs to make sure the new one won't have the "breaking" issue
header-layout.display: Other: We actually need to follow the best practices and try some designs to make sure the new one won't have the "breaking" issue
header-layout.note: It'd be important to also have in the Claude or Agents MD a rule for checking the card design to make sure a change is not turning that broken

pipeline-pill.title: Pipeline cards: where do the pipeline name, progress and active step go?
pipeline-pill.display: Pill keeps name + progress (name truncates, progress never does); active step gets its own line under the title
pipeline-pill.note: We need full name been seen. We can even have it as a sub card to the main card. Or a special "hat" in the UI when the card is a pipeline

progress-semantics.title: What should `n/total` mean for a pipeline with loops and branches?
progress-semantics.display: Distinct completed steps / total; a finished run reads `✓ Done`

exec-count.title: Where should the execution/loop count (e.g. "13 step runs · 2 loops") still appear?
exec-count.display: Board pill tooltip; Pipeline run-view header; `agetor show` / `agetor pipeline` output

action-row.title: How should the action row fit in 225 px?
action-row.display: Primary only + `⋯` menu (Diff goes in the menu too)

preview.title: What should the 2-line prompt preview show?
preview.display: First prose paragraph as plain text

a11y-items.title: Which accessibility items are in this change?
a11y-items.display: Visible `focus-visible` ring on the card (semantic `ring` token); Enter / Space on a focused card opens it (same as click); Fix the button-inside-a-button: card keeps whole-surface pointer drag, but its role becomes a labelled group instead of `button`; `aria-label` on every icon-only button; Keyboard dragging between columns (`KeyboardSensor`)

keyboard-drag-disposition.title: If keyboard dragging is not in this change: out of scope, or deferred by you?

density.title: Which density/consistency changes are in?
density.display: One chip system: one height (`h-5`), `text-[10px]`, `rounded-full`, same padding; colour carries the meaning; One button height on the card (`h-7` text and icon buttons); Card padding `p-4` → `p-3` (content 225 → 233 px); Workdir + branch on one line: repo folder name · branch (full path and branch in the tooltip)

verification.title: What has to pass before this is done?
verification.display: e2e: every child of the card stays inside the card's box, for each state (pipeline + profile + stack + long names; gate-pending; awaiting `Answer (12)`; all count badges); Unit: progress with a loop history (repeated stepIds), an untaken branch, and done/failed/cancelled runs; CLI `ls`/`show` tests updated; Unit: markdown-to-preview helper (headings, tables, fences, emphasis, links, empty); Screenshots of the card states in light and dark, attached to the PR; You eyeball it in `bun run dev:hmr` before merge

done-means.title: Anything else that must be true before you'd call this done?

amber.title: Answer button colour
amber.value: Replace `bg-amber-500 text-amber-950 …` with `bg-warning-solid` plus a new `--warning-solid-foreground` token (dark amber text, added to both `index.css` themes and `tailwind.config.js`). Card-local; the shared awaiting ring/glow and `StepNode` look stay unchanged.

done-dark.title: Done button in dark mode
done-dark.value: Card-local `bg-transparent` on the outline `Done` (no change to the shared Button variant).

no-overflow-hidden.title: No `overflow-hidden` on the card
no-overflow-hidden.value: Fix the flex layout instead of clipping; the card stays `overflow-visible`.

column-width.title: Column width
column-width.value: Columns stay `w-72`; resizable/wider columns are a different ticket.

primitives.title: Shared UI primitives
primitives.value: `ui/badge`, `ui/button`, `ui/card` variants are not changed; the card uses card-local classes (or a new, card-only chip component).

preview-helper-home.title: Where the preview helper lives
preview-helper-home.value: `src/mainview/lib/prompt-preview.ts` + sibling test (webview only; the CLI/TUI don't show prompt previews).

docs.title: Docs
docs.value: Update `task-context-menu.md` (card ↔ menu precedence, `⋯` entry), `pipelines.md` (progress rule), `PipelineBadge` doc comment, the header e2e spec comment; add a 'superseded by' note to `docs/plans/task-card-header-rows.md`.

mobile.title: Companion (mobile) app card
mobile.value: Out of scope: this change is the desktop webview card only.
